claims: Ezekiel 25:17 is a biblical verse focused on divine vengeance against nations that wronged Israel.
Many translations of Ezekiel 25:17 read "And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them."

The King James Version (KJV) of Ezekiel 25:17 reads "And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them."
Ezekiel 25:17 is commonly confused with a fictionalized, violent monologue from the movie Pulp Fiction.
